value.finger_proxies: 128 actual-triangle distal flexion-side patch samples per assigned finger
value.surface_sampling: clipped eligible source triangles, deterministic stratified area sampling
value.candidate: any same assigned distal patch point within inward finite fret cell, lateral3mm and signed plane height[-1,3]mm, facing cosine>=0.1, with distal body load
value.evidence: GPU net rigid body contact force and live source-mesh surface geometry
value.limitations: no body pair, contact witness, calibrated string force, pressure, vibration or sound; finite sampling can miss surface contacts
value.compatibility: new measurement; original pair-feature clean success is not inherited

wrong_press.effective: selected target geometry: own loaded facing distal pad at an unauthorized string/fret, or another finger at a higher fret on the target string; penalties only on audible overlap
wrong_press.own: positive assigned pad takes precedence over incidental own samples; any simultaneous active selected own target cell is authorized
wrong_press.other: full thumb/finger2/3 loaded virtual-string samples; same/lower fret is not wrong; higher blocks even with positive assigned pad
wrong_press.pad_geometry: finite unique nearest press-plane string within3mm, signed height[-1,3]mm, facing cosine>=0.1, distal netload>=0.01N, fret interior inset2mm
wrong_press.times: raw geometry at both physics endpoints, integrated over clipped audible overlap; no time-mask before trapezoid; overlapping sources do not multiply penalty
wrong_press.confidence: only unambiguous fret interiors contribute; no inferred wrong from unloaded/absent contact
wrong_press.source_fret_range: inclusive min/max contributing source fret per target/body; read only where source time>0
wrong_press.next_preparation: matches future scoped own finger/string/fret in press-2..onset; diagnostic only, never exempts current interference
wrong_press.scope: GPU left finger-skill only; net body force cannot identify contact partner, calibrated pressure or sound

fields.value: new loaded-body geometric candidates; not original pair-feature clean or acoustic success
diagnostic selected-task metrics; no stage weighting or mastery gate

value.standby: actual inverse-quadratic helper per_finger_rate integrated at240Hz; weighted reward excludes entire failed control tick exactly as environment
value.initial_quality_decline: quality below reset reference minus1e-6; completed240Hz fullgate==1 samples before own first press-2; absent fingers whole song; invalid reset/current angles excluded; no sample means evaluableFalse
value.recovery: fixed own-note-union gaps: previous end+0.05s release+1.0s provisional return budget through next press-0.35s; initial start1.05s, final end song duration; windows>=0.5s evaluated at80% planned occupancy; no policy gate in denominator; not a proven return-time guarantee
value.gate_runs: actual gate>0 and gate==1 completed240Hz endpoint runs; lengths/counts/band occupancy include ongoing runs; thresholds0.5/1/3s; no dynamic per-tick trace
value.wrist: absolute nearest-box delta by live guitar-local Gx/Gy/Gz; inclusive inside region; physics endpoint samples
value.thumb: minimum Euclidean distance from existing finite source thumb2/3 support vertices to finite source convex neck rear facets (outward normal Gz < -0.5); rear-side compatible permits signed plane gap >= -1 mm
value.thumb_limitation: legacy60Hz support vertices have no normals; shared thumb_support240Hz uses same-point patch position/normal and selected-point signed gap; neither certifies native contact pairs, pressure, sound, full mesh penetration or cooked collision geometry
value.thumb_support: shared helper rate at240Hz:0.01/s geometric quality plus0.01/s same-point quality times binary contact candidate; actual weighted payout uses completed-control failure suppression, approach weight and explicit multiplier0(off)/1(on); native net force and rear-normal load are resultant proxies, never pressure or contact-pair certification
value.thumb_contact_candidate: shared selected point signed gap[-0.001,0.0005]m, finite central neck-rear region, facing>=0.1, native thumb3 rear-normal load>=0.01N; force magnitude above threshold gives no further reward
value.thumb_normal_load: helper relu(native thumb3 resultant in guitar coordinates dot unit rear normal); mean denominator is helper normal_load_valid completed physics seconds
value.thumb_nearbutunloaded: near_geometry and normal_load_valid with rear-normal load<0.01N; excludes invalid loads and does not imply a known body pair
value.extreme_combinations: 240Hz geometric flags per finger: MCP<-20deg and PIP/DIP>60deg; MCP/PIP>75deg and DIP<10deg; DIP-PIP>50deg. Flags overlap and are diagnostics only; idle means outside own press..end, independent of B gate

fields.value: Original score windows intersected with actual phrase playback; initial preparation excluded. Unobserved time after failure remains in planned denominators.
